algorithm: SAM 2 image/video mask, lifted onto points
measurement_scope: One synthetic pinhole, SAM 2 tiny, z-buffer lift, shared Open3D box. Not a field image. The prompt is the generator stud centroid.

scene.name: stage0_2x4_lean0.050
scene.description: Synthetic single stud. Generator gravity is +Z.

pixel_agreement_with_generator_stud.note: Ratio of this mask against generator stud pixels on this render. The generator raster is not a field label.

visible_box.note: Minimal oriented box of the points lifted from this SAM 2 mask. The stud-length gate may still drop it, which leaves detection null. The network does not emit the box.

detection.note: One SAM 2 mask on the scaffold camera, lifted through the z-buffer. Counts are this synthetic render, not a field accuracy.

geometry.note: Section is the two smaller minimal-OBB extents versus the dressed nominal. Length is the longest extent versus the generator length. Gaussian tails and the plate slab margin both move these numbers.

angle.band_meaning: Percent of matched studs whose |measured - synthetic truth| is within the working tolerance.
angle.note: Truth is the generator chord. The network does not emit the angle. The shared box does. Not a SKIL reading.

paint.production_rule: epsilon unlocked, so every stud is yellow
paint.hypothetical_placeholder_note: 0.05 deg is a round illustration of the color rule. It is not a measured device band.
paint.note: Do not read hypothetical colors as a pass/fail call.

failure_modes: DBSCAN eps above the bay gap merges neighboring studs into one box.
DBSCAN eps below the surface spacing splits one stud into faces.
A plate side face left behind bridges bays.
Peeling a vertical stud-face plane would delete the wall.
PCA OBB on a short or one-sided cluster can yaw the long axis.
cost.note: Runtime is this process on this scene. It is not a field budget.

notes: Bake-off rank 7. Master-table row 7 remains ClearEdge3D EdgeWise.
Device epsilon is unlocked. Production paint is yellow when a box is kept.
The prompt is the centroid of generator stud pixels. It is not a field click.
